what: Turns the FM-1 into a two-part synth for the Novation Circuit Tracks: parts L and R follow MIDI 1 and 2 on split outputs, played from the Circuit's knobs. Twelve engines from DX7-style FM to Juno, CZ, acid and granular, 161 sounds, synced arp, drone and effects. Works with any MIDI keyboard too.
